item.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,693 as Altcoin Liquidity Shift Draws Attention
item.summary: Bitcoin closed at $78,692.656 on the Alpaca 5-min bar ending 2026-08-26 12:30 UTC, down 0.228308% over 24 hours within a narrow $77,847–$79,563 range, while CryptoQuant flagged a two-year high in altcoin volume dominance and elevated Binance USDC inflows.
